verdict.rationale: Community evidence confirms Teams has built-in screen sharing usable during calls (comm-18: 'I like the built-in screen sharing and that you can share a window rather than a screen'), and comm-1 confirms screen-share/annotation functionality exists though calls it slow and clunky to activate. No first-party docs in the pack specifically detail the screen-share admin workflow, so this rests mainly on mixed community hands-on reports rather than official documentation. Missing for 10: dedicated first-party docs on screen-share setup/permissions, admin controls for screen sharing, and independent corroboration beyond a single HN thread.
